sub_palette: classical (hellenic) backbone + north_american (plains) overlay (cross-family blend, Hellenic-leaning)

blend.backbone: classical (hellenic/greek register: the basileus/strategos rank-line, -os/-on/-ides names, retained aspirates th/ph/kh, the polis civic frame and the mystery-cult)
blend.overlay: north_american (plains horse-nomads: the band/division kin-frame, the war chief and warrior-society, vision-quest religion, open-vowel deed-names, paa/toya/soni/puuku terrain-roots)
blend.lean: Hellenic-heavy - Greek horse-lords of the open grassland: a Hellenic war-aristocracy (the basileus and his companion-society) over a mounted Plains war-clan substrate; the polis-frame, the rank-ladder and the mystery-cult lead, the grass-sea, the herd and the vision-quest endure beneath.

_note: NEW cross-family hybrid under the base/hybrid model. BASE_07 Achillean (Greek/Hellenic) x BASE_11 Numinan (Plains horse-nomads). Concept: Greek horse-lords of the plains - a Hellenic people who wed the polis, the bronze-panoply and the mystery-cult to the Plains horse-raid, the war-band and the vision-quest; a single emergent people of the grass-sea, neither Greek nor Plains. Backbone = Hellenic (Greek: the basileus/strategos rank-line, -os/-on/-ides names, the mystery-cult, the polis civic frame); overlay/substrate = Plains (the band/division kin-frame, the war chief and warrior-society, the vision-quest, the open-vowel terrain-roots). CIV/CLAN by inheritance: a Greek/Hellenic (Civilized) parent and a Plains (Clanhold) parent, and any Civ parent -> Civ, so Thracan is Civilized (feudal) - a polis-of-tents over the war-clans. Common-word lexicon and rank titles use the real Greek and Plains registers (allowed, catalog 5.3); DEITY names are morphs of the Agrippan canon from both parents (Hellenic reflexes primary, Plains variants secondary), never real Greek/Plains gods. All human cultures allow Lawful/Neutral/Chaotic (the ordered war-host, the herding peace, the raid-frenzy). Ruler/domain DISPLAY titles are English (or an approved commonly-known foreign term - Archon for county); the *_native conlang forms are for NPC dialogue only. [REWORKED 2026-06-28 to base/hybrid model: csv_id HYB_49; all-three alignment; English display titles + native; deep-fusion lexicon + fusion_rules.]

phonology.palette: Hellenic (Greek) backbone - aspirates th/ph/kh, -os/-on/-es/-eus/-ides endings, the patronymic -id-, moderate onset clusters (st/tr/pr/kl/kt/pt), penultimate stress - meeting a Plains overlay: open flowing vowels, glottal stops, the barred-u (written u), -bi/-pu/-tu/-wa endings and CV(C) descriptive deed-roots. Harsh aspirate-and-cluster Greek over open Plains vowels; theophoric on the Hellenic reflexes (Toravios-, Orlantos-) with Plains construct variants (Torawi-, Olanta-).
phonology.phonotactics: CV / CVC; Greek clusters (kt/pt/st/ph/th/kh) softening toward Plains open vowels; vowel-final preferred; -os/-on/-ides over -bi/-wa/-tu Plains endings; glottal stop in the Plains substrate.

sound_changes: Plains glottal stops and bare CV roots take a Greek frame: a Greek onset-cluster or aspirate is admitted, and the word ends -os/-on/-a/-ides; the barred-u (u) -> Greek u/o
Plains terminal -bi/-pu/-tu/-hubi reduce or fuse: kept as a softened medial (-b-/-p-) under a Greek ending, not a final inflection
Greek penultimate stress and aspirates (th/ph/kh) on all words; Greek clusters (kt/pt/st/ph/kh) permitted; geminates allowed
retain Greek th/ph/kh and -os/-ides AND the Plains open-vowel flow and a few signature roots (paa-, toya-, soni-, puuku-, taabe-); every root then filtered to one Hellenic-shaped phonology
fusion_rules.source_tilt: land/terrain, beast/herd, mountain and material/staple words from Plains roots (the substrate works the grass and the herd: paa water, toya mountain, soni grass, puuku horse, kutsu bison); rule/rank, kin-line, civic and abstract land-of-rule words from Greek roots (the ruling register: basileus, strategos, polis, -ides, hieros); every root then run through one Greek-shaped sound-law so the split is invisible at the surface

lexicon._note: Single fused tongue derived via phonology.fusion_rules (gdd-hybrid-conlang-fusion.md): Plains terrain/beast/material-roots + Greek rule/kin/civic-roots, all run through one Hellenic-shaped sound-law (Greek aspirates, clusters and -os/-on/-ides endings over the Plains open-vowel flow); portmanteaus mark the blended institutions and bloodline of the grass-sea.

morphology.patronymic_form: patronymic -ides (Greek) fused with the band-name (genonumu); a deed- or vision-name earned at the first raid; an animal+quality byname.
morphology.compounding_rule: [quality|animal](stem) + feature: Mel-orotoya (black-mountain), Hippuku-pedsoni (horse-plain); the band named for its deed or its herd; -polis for the tent-cities.

title_ladder.government: feudal (a Hellenic war-aristocracy over the mounted Plains war-clans of the grass-sea: the war-king and his companion-society at the crown, the strategos-generals over the band-musters, the toparch-lords sworn to the war-host; the assembly of riders and the mystery-cult raise and check the war-king)
title_ladder._tiers_note: Fused Hellenic-Plains ladder, ascending, with the Greek-Plains co-titles beneath. Toparnan (lord; Gk toparch + Plains nantan) barony; Phrourwap (border war-chief; Gk phrour- + Plains tekwuniwap) march; Eparaibo (district-chief; Gk eparch + Plains paraibo) county, shown as Archon (the commonly-known Greek civic magistracy); Strategwa (war-general; Gk strategos) duchy; Dynaraibo (great-chief prince; Gk dynastes + Plains pia-paraibo) principality; Basinaika (war-king; Gk basileus + Plains naika) kingdom; Autoknaika (high war-king; Gk autokrator + Plains naika) empire. The assembly of riders and the mystery-cult check the war-king. Rank titles fuse the real Greek and Plains registers (allowed).
title_ladder.heir: Diadnaika (the war-king's successor-designate; Gk diadochos + naika)
title_ladder.display_policy: Ruler/domain titles shown in setting-gen, domain lists and vassal trees are ENGLISH (or an approved commonly-known foreign term where set in 'ruler' - Archon at county). The *_native conlang forms are for NPC DIALOGUE ONLY, never for structural/UI displays.

people_name_convention.order: a child-name, replaced at the first raid by a deed- or vision-name; the genonumu (war-band-clan); a Greek -ides patronymic for the high-born; an animal+quality byname.
people_name_convention.dual_register: the war-king and companion-society bear deed-names and Greek honor-styles; others a band-name + vision-name.
people_name_convention.theophoric: names invoke the sky, sun and war-powers + a fused element: -machos (war), Hipp- (horse), Mel- (black), or a vision-sign: e.g. Maraksios-machos, Hipp-toravios.

religion._note: Deity-names are morphs of the Agrippan canon - Hellenic Greek reflexes PRIMARY (the hellenic morphs, -os/-on/-ios; th/ph/kh), Plains variants SECONDARY (the family_north_american theonym_sets.plains morphs), never real Greek/Plains gods. Thracan allows Lawful/Neutral/Chaotic; its stance follows its CURRENT alignment (see worship_by_alignment). The powers are met in the mystery-rite and the vision-quest, under the open sky and at the kurgan-tomb; the war-king is initiate and war-leader both.
religion.the_one: Aiterunos (< Aeternus; fused Hellenic Aiternos / Plains Ateruna) - the Sky-Eternal over the grass-sea; revered when Lawful, acknowledged as the distant maker when Neutral, reviled as the cold tyrant when Chaotic

Tulrius.gloss: the sun, the just light; Lawful power

Maraxus.gloss: the war-fire, the raid; Chaotic power

worship_by_alignment.Lawful: revere the One (Aiterunos) and the Lawful powers (Toravios, Orlantos, Numawios, Gaiantos), demonize the Chaotic powers (Maraksios, Tamawios, Lusantios)
worship_by_alignment.Neutral: all powers ambivalent - somewhat honored, somewhat feared; foreground the ancestral war-dead, the herd- and sky-spirits and the vision-medicine (puha) of place; the great powers invoked at the kurgan and the mystery-precinct situationally
worship_by_alignment.Chaotic: venerate the Chaotic powers (Maraksios the war-fire, Tamawios the storm, the raid-frenzy of the mystery-rite), demonize the Lawful powers and the One

religion.demon_epithet_pattern: the demonized set (by current alignment) take dread epithets: when Lawful - Maraxus -> Maraksios the War-Fire (Plains Maraksa the Raider), Dementus -> Tamawios the Mad-Storm; when Chaotic - Tulrius -> Toravios the Cold-Sun (Plains Torawi), Aeternus -> Aiterunos the Sky-Tyrant.
religion.religious_orders_pattern: the Tem-shinato (mystery-precinct and sacred cairn) of [power] on the high ground: 'the Tem-shinato of Maraksios', and the vision-rite of the riders.
religion.saints_pattern: the great war-kings and mystery-initiates who became sky-riders; honored at the kurgan-tomb and the mystery-precinct.

holy_symbol_motifs.Toravios: a radiate sun above a galloping horse
holy_symbol_motifs.Maraksios: a bronze spear and horsetail-standard beneath a thunder-cloud
holy_symbol_motifs.Tamawios: the forked storm over the grass-sea

banks_patterns.ships: (horse-lords of the grass) the war-standards and famed steeds bear names, not ships: 'Storm-Mane', 'the Bronze Lance', 'Wind-Drinker' (a famed horse)
banks_patterns.military_units: the companion-society and the rider-host: the [animal] Hetairoi (companions) / the [chief] riders: 'the Wolf-Companions', 'the Storm-Riders'
banks_patterns.taverns: the wine-tent and the war-feast: 'the Bronze Kylix', 'the Mare's-Milk Tent'
banks_patterns.dungeons_ruins: kurgan barrow-tombs and abandoned tent-polis grounds: 'the Kurgan of [war-king]', 'the Ghost-Camp of [band]'
